This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Kenobi II" /> [[Borrim Shub]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Topps" />

==Biology and appearance==
This hulking bipedal [[species]] was distinguished by their large features,<ref name="Kenobi II" /> including a massive head, wideset, circular [[Tooth|teeth]], [[Color|yellow]] irises in their [[eye]]s, and long black and gray [[hair]], as well as black and pink toned skin.<ref name="Topps" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One member of this species, [[Borrim Shub]], found itself<ref name="Topps" /> on the [[Daiyu City|city]] streets of the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]<ref name="Kenobi II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> by [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part II}} to [[9 BBY]].</ref> where they briefly encountered the [[human]] [[Youngling|child]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who nearly ran into the alien while fleeing.<ref name="Kenobi II" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the limited television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'',<ref name="Kenobi II" /> which was released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref>
